
### DNSSEC deployment: validation 


* queries supporting validation: approx. 36% 

   * from [https://stats.labs.apnic.net/dnssec/](https://stats.labs.apnic.net/dnssec/)

* approx. 46% recursive resolvers support  

   * from [https://ithi.research.icann.org/](https://ithi.research.icann.org/)
